intro: Cinq media unit blends clean geometry with modern adaptability. Elevated on a tubular steel frame and finished in a neutral tone, it anchors entertainment spaces while keeping essentials organised.

features.title: Sleek neutral design for adaptable interiors
features.text: Cinq’s clean lines and neutral-tone finish allow it to integrate effortlessly into evolving décor styles. The minimalist silhouette keeps the space feeling open and contemporary.

features.title: Elegant tubular steel frame for airy structure
features.text: The slender steel frame of this media unit elevates the unit visually and physically. This refined base adds lightness while ensuring dependable structural strength.

features.title: Drawer storage for organised essentials
features.text: Integrated drawers provide concealed storage for remotes, cables, and everyday items. This keeps your media zone tidy without disrupting the clean aesthetic.

features.title: Elevated base for easy maintenance
features.text: Raised on slender yet sturdy legs, the sideboard maintains an open and uncluttered appearance while allowing convenient floor cleaning underneath.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
